subject: sg-miles-card
note: WHAT THIS SWEEP IS, AND IS NOT. The documents are private contract terms that the issuers may vary 'without notice' (every one of them says so), so a modification is not a court striking a clause but an issuer publishing a newer edition or announcing a change. The sweep therefore asks, for each issuer, whether a newer edition or an announced change exists that the held edition does not state, using web search against the three Singapore miles blogs and the issuers' own pages. Primary documents (the issuers' PDFs and pages) were each re-fetched and their digests recorded in registers/source-bundle.json; re-fetching proves unchanged bytes, not currency, which is the reason for the searches. NO court, regulator or legislative search was run: nothing in this row is law, and no dispute about any of these documents is known to the encoder. Secondary sources are blogs that quote the issuers; they are used to find primary documents and to flag disagreement, and no encoded value rests on one except where a fork says so.

searches.question: Has Citibank announced a date after which the Citi Rewards Visa and Citi PremierMiles Visa stop earning, and has anything changed in the Citi Rewards 10X terms?
searches.scope: Web search results (MileLion, Mainly Miles, SuiteSmile, Instarem) for 'Citi Visa credit cards Singapore discontinued 2026 last day of use', read 2026-10-21; plus a second search for Citi Miles programme terms (extended mode).
searches.query: Citi Visa credit cards Singapore discontinued 2026 last day of use Citi Rewards Visa Signature points transfer to Mastercard
searches.coverage_note: Covers only what the blogs quote. The search found no Citi page stating the discontinuation date; Citi's own FAQ (held) states none. It did not read the notification letters Citi sent cardholders, and it cannot say whether a given Citi Rewards card is a Visa or a Mastercard.

searches.question: Is there a DBS yuu Card change announced or in force after the held 7 August 2026 edition?
searches.scope: Web search results for DBS yuu card changes October 2026 (MileLion, SingSaver, DBS promotion pages), read 2026-10-21.
searches.query: DBS yuu card changes October 2026 yuu merchants removed bonus yuu points cap American Express 7-Eleven
searches.coverage_note: Found no report of a change after 7 August 2026. The latest changes it found (1 May 2026 exclusions; 1 October 2025 S$800 minimum and merchant changes) are already stated in the held edition. It did not read the yuu app, where the merchant list and the 'full list of exclusions' that Appendix 1 refers to actually live; the held edition therefore cannot be said to state the current merchant list.

searches.question: Is there a DBS Woman's World Card earn change announced or in force after the held 27 July 2026 edition?
searches.scope: Web search results for DBS Woman's World Card changes 2026 (MileLion, Mainly Miles, SingSaver), read 2026-10-21.
searches.query: DBS Woman's World Card changes 2026 online spend S$1,000 cap annual fee waiver MileLion
searches.coverage_note: The only 2026 change it found is the end of the automatic annual-fee waiver from 1 August 2026, which does not touch what a purchase earns. It did not search the DBS site's announcements page.

searches.question: Is there an HSBC Revolution earn change announced or in force after the held edition effective 1 April 2026?
searches.scope: Web search results for HSBC Revolution credit card changes 2026 (MileLion, Mainly Miles, SingSaver), read 2026-10-21.
searches.query: HSBC Revolution credit card changes 2026 10 mpd contactless online nerf cap Everyday Global Account 8 mpd
searches.coverage_note: The blogs describe exactly the edition held (contactless and travel restored from 1 April 2026, 9,000 and 22,800 bonus-point caps, the S$50,000 Deposits ADB tier). One blog says the card was upgraded to Visa Signature; the held edition names no card tier and the report changes no rule in it. HSBC's own announcements page was not read.

searches.question: Is there a UOB Lady's Solitaire, Preferred Visa, Visa Signature or PRVI Miles earn change after the held editions?
searches.scope: Web search results for UOB card changes effective October or November 2026 (Mainly Miles, MileLion, InsideFlyer), read 2026-10-21.
searches.query: UOB Lady's Solitaire OR "UOB Preferred Visa" OR "UOB Visa Signature" OR "UOB PRVI Miles" changes effective October 2026 OR November 2026 bonus cap categories
searches.coverage_note: Found nothing for Lady's Solitaire or Visa Signature. The PRVI Miles American Express loyalty-bonus threshold rise to S$80,000 and the quarterly 5,000-mile foreign-spend bonus that it found are both already stated in the held Ver 3.4. It did not read UOB's announcements page, and a UOB notice to cardmembers that is not on the web would not appear.

searches.question: Has the PAssion POSB Debit Card yuu promotion, which the held edition ends on 31 December 2026, been extended or replaced?
searches.scope: Web search results for PAssion POSB debit card yuu 18X promotion extended 2027 or ending 31 December 2026 (SingSaver, MileLion 28 May 2026, onepa.gov.sg, POSB), read 2026-10-21.
searches.query: PAssion POSB debit card yuu 18X promotion extended 2027 OR ending 31 December 2026
searches.coverage_note: Found no announcement of an extension or replacement, and no page that states the end date other than the held edition itself. A silence in blogs is not evidence that no extension is coming; POSB announces such things late. The search did not read the yuu app.

searches.question: Is there a Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card (Singapore) change after the held clause text, and does anything contradict it?
searches.scope: Web search results for the Singapore Smart card (MileLion review 6 February 2026, SingSaver, Seedly, MoneySmart), read 2026-10-21; the MileLion review was also fetched and read.
searches.query: Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card Singapore McDonald's Netflix SimplyGo bonus merchants cashback review 2026 MileLion OR SingSaver
searches.coverage_note: The first search returned only other countries' Smart cards. The second, aimed at Singapore, found the MileLion review, which agrees with the held clause text on the S$800 and S$1,500 tiers and on bus/MRT via SimplyGo, and disagrees on the end date of the EV-charging bonus. Seedly and SingSaver pages were not read in full and are partly out of date (one still shows the 6% structure the held PDF of Version 1 August 2024 describes).

searches.question: Does a Standard Chartered document dated after the held web-page clause text say anything different about the Smart card's EV-charging bonus?
searches.scope: Web searches for the Smart card's EV-charging bonus and its end date, 2026-10-22. The MileLion article of 8 January 2026 was fetched and its link to a Standard Chartered PDF followed. The PDF, Standard Chartered's Smart card FAQ page and its Smart card product page were fetched and read.
searches.query: Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card EV charging bonus cashback extended 2026
searches.coverage_note: The MileLion article links the PDF as 'updated its T&Cs'. The PDF is a static file at av.sc.com headed 'Version 13 November 2025' and says 31 December 2026. The sc.com web T&C page, the FAQ page and the product page, all fetched 2026-10-22, still say 31 December 2025. No Standard Chartered announcement of the extension turned up in these searches, so the PDF is the only primary evidence of it. The pages' Last-Modified headers changed between two fetches on the same day and were not used as evidence.

searches.question: What does Trust Bank say, in its own words, about how Freedom card Trust Miles are earned and converted?
searches.scope: trustbank.sg/freedom-credit-card/miles/ and trustbank.sg/legal/trust-miles-redemption-terms-and-conditions/, read and digested 2026-10-21; plus a web search for MileLion, SingSaver and MoneySmart coverage.
searches.query: Trust Freedom credit card miles mode earn rate per S$1 Max Miles terms and conditions ongoing rewards 2026
searches.coverage_note: Not a search for a modification: it found two documents, both now in the bundle. The earn rate (1.3 Trust Miles per S$1, awarded per S$5) is stated on the product page only, which is marketing and not terms and conditions; no terms and conditions state it. The blogs agree with the page. A Freedom card terms-and-conditions document (the 'Trust / NTUC Link credit card product terms' that the Spend & Get promotion cites for eligible spend) was not found.

entries.summary: MileLion (12 July 2026) reports that Citi will discontinue the Citi Rewards Visa on 15 October 2026, with 14 October 2026 the last day of use. Citi's own Visa discontinuation FAQ (Version June 2026, held) states no date: it says only that 'You will only earn Citi ThankYou Points/Citi Miles/cash back for transactions posted before Visa is discontinued.' So the date on which a Citi Visa stops earning is a blog's report of a notice the encoder has not seen.

provenance.source: MileLion, 'Citi Rewards Visa to be discontinued on 15 October 2026'
provenance.citation: milelion.com, 12 July 2026; corroborated by mainlymiles.com 8 August 2026 and suitesmile.com 11 July 2026 (search results only)

entries.disposition_note: citi-visa-wind-down.l4 takes the discontinuation date as a named constant marked Unconfirmed, and states the earn rule from the held FAQ (posted before discontinuation earns; posted after does not) independently of the date.

entries.summary: Mainly Miles reports that the Citi PremierMiles Visa was retired at the start of 2026. The held Cardmember's Agreement is for the 'Citibank PremierMiles Visa/Mastercard' and says nothing of a withdrawal. The encoding therefore carries the Visa variant as a constructor, and the fork records that it may no longer be issued.

provenance.source: Mainly Miles, 'Last two months for the Citi Rewards Visa card' (search result text)
provenance.citation: mainlymiles.com, 8 August 2026; the retirement report was read in the search-result summary only, not in the article body

routing.effective_from_absent_reason: The summary says 'at the start of 2026' and no day; the article body was not read.

entries.disposition_note: Both PremierMiles networks earn the same under the held programme terms (cl.3.1 names no network), so the question changes no rate; the fork records it so a reader does not take the Visa constructor as a statement that the card exists.

entries.summary: The held PAssion edition ends the Promotion at 31 December 2026 (cl.3: 'The Promotion is valid from 1 October 2025 to 31 December 2026'). After that date the held terms award nothing. No extension or successor was found.

provenance.citation: PAssion POSB Debit Card Promotion T&C, cl.3, updated as of 29 April 2026
provenance.quote: The Promotion is valid from 1 October 2025 to 31 December 2026

entries.disposition_note: posb-passion.l4 answers for a transaction date: inside the Promotion Period it applies the tiers, outside it answers that the held terms award nothing (not that the card is worthless: the card's ordinary DBS/POSB rewards are not held).

entries.summary: The held web-page clause text says the EV-charging (MCC 5552) bonus 'is only applicable from 6 December 2024 to 31 December 2025'. The Standard Chartered PDF headed 'Version 13 November 2025', held since 2026-10-22, says 31 December 2026, as do MileLion's articles of 8 January 2026 (which links that PDF) and 6 February 2026, both secondary. Two Standard Chartered documents therefore disagree by a year.

provenance.source: Standard Chartered Smart Credit Card Promotion Terms and Conditions, Version 13 November 2025 (PDF)
provenance.citation: av.sc.com PDF, cl.5 footnote, first page
provenance.quote: Bonus 360° Rewards Points earned from spends charged to EV charging merchants is only applicable from 6 December 2024 to 31 December 2026.

routing.effective_from_absent_reason: The PDF states a version date (13 November 2025) and no effective date for the extension.

entries.disposition_note: sc-smart.l4 takes the PDF: EV charging is a Bonus Merchant on a purchase posted from 6 December 2024 to 31 December 2026, and a purchase posted after that earns only the non-bonus rate. The web page's reading (ended 31 December 2025) stays live in the fork. Assumed, not ruled.
